owner.name: Wilson — Granja Viana
owner.notes: Real-estate agent, Granja Viana / Cotia (São Paulo). High-end residential; gated communities. Handle @wilson_one2022. Reference brand for the media_creation module (design-system.md is the full source).

brandings.name: Wilson Premium
brandings.persona: Voice: editorial, calm, premium real-estate. The image suggests more than it states — the reader feels exclusivity, not promotion. Forbidden: hype, exclamations, sales-y language, generic stock real-estate. Audience: families 35-55, high / upper-middle income, São Paulo metro, seeking gated communities in Granja Viana (security + space + quality of life + appreciation). Hook in the first 7 words; one idea per slide.
brandings.design_system: Variant: premium (default). Warm dark, sober, high-end. Palette: bg #2A2620 (warm dark olive) / deep #1A1612 / gold #C5A55E / off-white #F5F1EA / muted #A89B85. Typography: Cormorant Garamond (serif display, 1 word may be gold-highlighted) + Inter (sans body). Canvas 1080x1350 (4:5). Roles: cover (hook over full-bleed photo) / develop (headline + bullets + curved-arch photo) / insight (typographic statement) / cta (gold pill button). Photography: architecture / interiors / landscape / lifestyle — golden-hour warm tones, ~30-40% negative space, NEVER agent-posing or stock handshakes. Handle @wilson_one2022 bottom-left every slide; 'GRANJA VIANA' gold pin on cover+cta. Full source: design-system.md.

brandings.name: Wilson Educational
brandings.persona: Same editorial premium voice, in an accessible / didactic register — for tutorials, listicles, dicas. Clear, scannable, but never hype. Audience identical to premium; tone is teaching, not selling.
brandings.design_system: Variant: educational (lite). Accessible, scannable. Palette: lavender-grey #E8E5F0 / navy royal #3A4FB8 / yellow #F0E63A accents. Same Cormorant + Inter type and the same 4 slide roles + canvas as premium. Use only when the brief is explicitly tutorial / listicle; premium is the default. Full source: design-system.md.
